item.text: I’m taking a different refactor direction now: the code has accumulated too many thin abstractions for a tiny program. I’m going to simplify the architecture by collapsing the default wiring and CLI workflow back into a smaller, more coherent set of classes while keeping the request/result types and tests.

The current design is over-layered for the size of the program. I’m collapsing the workflow into the core search class and CLI, with the goal of deleting several pass-through classes rather than adding more.

I’m simplifying aggressively now: moving the algorithm and formatting back into `NaivePatternSearch`, moving CLI parsing into `NaivePatternSearchCli`, and deleting the intermediate service/runtime classes that no longer justify their existence.
The core logic is simplified. I’m updating the tests to target the smaller surface area and removing assertions that only existed for the deleted plumbing layers.
I’ve removed the test dependence on the service layer. Next I’m deleting the now-redundant classes so the repo actually reflects the simplified design instead of carrying dead architecture.
The simplification is in place. I’m compiling what remains and running the CLI plus tests to confirm the smaller architecture still covers all behavior.

item.text:
Refactored the codebase by simplifying it, not adding more layers. [NaivePatternSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearch.java:1) now owns the actual search algorithm and result formatting again, and [NaivePatternSearchCli.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearchCli.java:1) owns the CLI defaults and argument parsing directly.

That let me delete the thin pass-through architecture that had grown around the program: `NaiveSearchEngine`, `SearchApplication`, `SearchCliSupport`, `SearchEngine`, `SearchRequestParser`, `SearchResultFormatter`, and `SearchRuntime`. [NaivePatternSearchTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearchTest.java:1) was updated to verify the same behavior against the smaller surface area.
